title: Knowledge Check

Statement_01.text: Three questions follow the content. No trick questions — each tests a key concept from the module.

visual_notes: Section divider, then 3 MC questions. No narration on divider. Questions are stand-alone interactive screens.

questions.question: What does being at the midpoint of your pay range indicate?

options.text: You are paid fairly for a fully competent performer in the role
You have been in your role for many years
You should expect a significant pay increase soon

questions.feedback_correct: Right. Midpoint represents market-competitive pay for someone performing well in the role — and remember, the market range extends around the midpoint, not just above it.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Midpoint represents market-competitive pay for a fully capable performer — not a sign of underperformance or concern.

questions.question: Two employees have the same job title but different pay levels. Which of the following is a legitimate reason?

options.text: One negotiated harder when they were first hired
One has more specialized skills, longer tenure, and a stronger performance track record
One has a better personal relationship with their manager
Pay differences within the same role are never legitimate

questions.feedback_correct: Exactly. Skills, tenure, and sustained performance are among the legitimate factors that can create pay differences within the same role.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Individual factors — skills, performance, tenure, location — create legitimate pay differences within the same role.

questions.question: Beyond base pay, which of the following is part of your total rewards at Brunswick?

options.text: Nothing — base pay is your total compensation
Only your annual bonus, if you receive one
Benefits, paid time off (PTO), retirement contributions, incentive compensation, and wellness programs
Pay ranges listed on job listings

questions.feedback_correct: Right. Base pay is one component — benefits, retirement contributions, incentive compensation, and wellness programs are all part of the full value Brunswick provides.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Base pay is only one component of total rewards. Benefits, retirement contributions, incentive compensation, and wellness programs are all part of the full picture.
